nodes.label: BornoLab Naming
nodes.rationale: borno means letter, lab means workshop. Chosen as short, spellable, brandable over LipiLab, AkhorHub, LekhaForge, LipiGhar, Mudran, KagojKit.

nodes.label: BN EN Pipeline Separation
nodes.rationale: EN and BN pipelines kept separate because of font variation: different shaping and line-height needs, SutonnyMJ legacy must convert to Unicode first, different numbering and ToC leaders. Never mix pipelines or apply EN serif metrics to BN glyphs.

nodes.label: Mock Data Fallback Principle
nodes.rationale: No env needed to run; without webhook URLs return mock execution plan so UI never breaks. Client-fast with in-browser libs and graceful fallback until real TTF files added.

nodes.label: Keep Tree Clean Commit Principle
nodes.rationale: Removing the managed block from a diff only re-creates the change; committing it with work keeps the tree clean. Verify generator at node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/generate-agent-files.js.
